question: How did two scientists get a sheet of carbon one atom thick?
answer: Graphite is many sheets of carbon stacked loosely. Tape pulls the top sheets away, and peeling again and again leaves some flakes only one atom thick. In 2004, Geim and Novoselov made graphene this way, with no complex chemistry.
move: Graphene was first made by peeling graphite with tape down to one layer.
